WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate,
    AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM fees
  WHERE rebrate > 0.0005
  GROUP BY orderslink
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    avg_total_rebate,
    avg_ratio,
    avg_ratio / NULLIF(AVG(avg_ratio) OVER (), 0) AS relative_ratio
  FROM per_order
)
SELECT orderslink, avg_total_rebate, avg_ratio, relative_ratio
FROM normalized
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
